name: re2-pattern
description: A regular expression RE2 and an ECMAScript engine with the u flag both accept and match identically, as one closed allowlist: literal characters, escaped punctuation, \t \n \r \f \v, \xHH, the assertions ^ $ \b \B, \d \D \w \W, classes with negation and ranges, \p{…} / \P{…} with a General_Category short name, (…) and (?:…) groups, alternation, and * + ? {n} {n,} {n,m}, optionally lazy, with counts up to 1000. Everything else is refused by name: lookaround, backreferences, named groups, inline flags, '.', \s and \S (each engine matches a different set), \u…, \x{…}, \cX, \0 and octal escapes, \pL without braces, scripts and long property names, POSIX classes, \A \z \Z \Q \E \C, and counts above 1000.
